# MakeTrades

> MakeTrades is a white-label brokerage platform for launching forex brokers, crypto exchanges, and dealing centers. Turnkey solution from $1000-3000/month with 500+ trading instruments, CRM, mobile apps, trading bots marketplace, and prop trading support.

## Company Information

- [About MakeTrades](https://maketrades.info): White-label platform for creating brokerages, crypto exchanges and dealing centers
- [FAQ](https://maketrades.info/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about pricing, features, support, and integration
- [Blog](https://maketrades.info/blog.html): Articles about trading, brokerage business, technology, and market analysis

## Core Features

- Trading Terminals: Web, desktop and mobile terminals with real-time quotes for 500+ instruments (forex, crypto, stocks, indices)
- Mobile Apps: Custom-branded iOS and Android applications published to App Store and Google Play
- CRM System: Full-featured broker CRM with lead management, client segmentation, and automated workflows
- Trading Bots Marketplace: JavaScript-based bot store where traders create, sell, and use automated strategies
- Crypto Processing: Built-in cryptocurrency deposit and withdrawal processing
- White Label: Fully customizable branding, domain, logos, and design
- Social Trading: Copy trading and PAMM/MAM accounts for investment portfolios
- Partner Program: Multi-level IB (Introducing Broker) cabinet with commission tracking
- Prop Trading: Proprietary trading and binary options integration
- API: RESTful API for payment systems, third-party services, and custom integrations
- Flexible Configuration: Customizable spreads, commissions, and instrument parameters

## Pricing

- Monthly rental: $1000-3000/month depending on configuration
- 200+ companies already use the platform
- 24/7 technical support included
- No setup fees for standard configuration

## Technology

- Platform: Cloud-based SaaS with multi-region deployment
- Security: KYC/AML compliance, SSL encryption, 2FA
- Integration: MetaTrader bridge, payment gateways, liquidity providers
- Languages: Russian, English (UI and support)
